tiktok_extended_cut_s.note: TikTok Creator Rewards pays only for videos of 60s or more; add 1-2 context beats, keep the same hook

beat_timing_pattern.purpose: accusation or reversal claim; caption on screen from frame 0
tease the exception or payoff; must end by 3.5s
the viewer's own experience of the thing
history or mechanism, one idea per beat
the reveal of what actually happens
re-raise the open loop just before the payoff
answer the open loop with a visual action
a line that grammatically flows into beat 1; final frame matches frame 0

required_devices.rule: Something is already moving on frame 0 (a finger pressing, a shape mid-pop, the camera mid-push). No fade-in, no black or blank frame, no title card.
required_devices.check: frame t=0 differs visibly from t=0.2; no opacity<0.9 on hero layer at frame 0

required_devices.rule: The spoken claim is complete and the headline caption is fully legible by 1.5s.
An unanswered question exists by about 3s (who? why? which one?).
A visible pattern interrupt at least every 3s: a scene cut, zoom punch, new cutout entering, a colour flip, or a counter. SFX on at least half of them.
Any jump to the past gets a fast rewind whip of 0.3-0.5s with SFX (the biggest drop-off risk point).
required_devices.check: beat with a year in caption has motion in [whip, rewind, pullout+sfx]

required_devices.rule: Re-raise the hook question before the payoff ('But there's one person...').
required_devices.check: a beat in this window has motion=tease or caption containing ONE/WHO/EXCEPT/BUT

required_devices.rule: The payoff lands late, is shown as an action (not just said), and has a distinct SFX.
The last line flows into the first line; the last frame matches frame 0's composition (same object, size, position, background); no end card, logo, fade or silence tail over 0.15s; music bar wraps.
required_devices.check: SSIM(first_frame, last_frame) >= 0.6 on hero region; tail silence <= 0.15s

subtitles.style: burned-in, word-by-word or 2-4 word chunks, white with charcoal 6px stroke, active word in #F5C518
subtitles.note: The bottom ~440px is covered by IG's caption/username UI and the right ~120px by the action buttons; keep all text out of those areas.

headline.highlight: exactly one word in #F5C518 per headline
headline.rule: The headline must not repeat the subtitle verbatim; it is the beat's idea compressed to 4 words or fewer.

cover.source_frame: beat 1 hero composition (not a mid-transition frame)
text_rules: Must be a complete claim that makes sense without audio
Contain the searchable object noun (e.g. ELEVATOR BUTTON)
Text centred within the 1080x1440 (3:4) crop so the profile grid does not cut it
No question-only covers; a claim beats a question

rules: Line 1 is the plain-language search query (e.g. 'Why the elevator close door button doesn't work') with the object noun in the first 5 words
Never give away the payoff in the caption; tease it
share_prompt names a specific person to send it to ('Send this to the friend who...')
Keep hedges from the script (often, many, some)
A question answerable in 1 word (yes/no, a number, a city) to lower comment friction
Always include at least one source
Post within 60s of publishing, then pin

criteria.relatability: Has the average viewer personally touched/seen this thing? 5 = daily
criteria.surprise: Does the answer contradict what most people assume? 5 = flips a belief
criteria.shareability: Is there an obvious person to send it to (friend who does X, group chat)? 5 = named recipient obvious
criteria.visual_potential: Can it be shown with paper cutouts and a physical action, not just text? 5 = clear visual payoff
criteria.fact_solidity: Primary/authoritative source exists and the claim needs at most light hedging. 5 = regulation/official source; 3 = needs strong hedging; <=2 reject

auto_reject_if: relies on a single unsourced viral claim
tragedy within the last 30 days used as a hook
checklist: Can the hook be said in 8 words or fewer?
Is there a twist or exception to use as the open loop?
Is there a physical action for the payoff (key turns, light dims, pane cracks)?
Who exactly would you DM this to?
Do two independent sources agree? Note the hedge words required.

hook_templates.pattern: That {small detail} is there in case {dramatic thing}.
In {year}, {event} quietly changed every {object} you use.
You're not imagining it: {complaint} is on purpose.
Only {group} knows what this {detail} is for.

qa_checklist.check: Frame 0 has visible motion and the hero object; no fade/blank/title card
Spoken claim complete <= 1.6s and headline legible from frame 0
No gap > 3.75s without a pattern interrupt (cut, zoom punch, new element, colour flip, counter)
Headline <= 4 words, one yellow highlight word, inside the top safe zone (y 220-520 @1080x1920)
Subtitles inside safe zone (not below y=1480, not right of x=960), <= 2 lines, <= 18 chars/line, no overlap with headline or hero object's key detail
Subtitle words within 120ms of TTS word timing on 5 random spot-checks
Payoff beat starts at 78-92% of runtime and is shown as an action with SFX
Last line flows into first line; last frame composition matches frame 0; tail silence <= 0.15s; no end card/logo
Cover frame: claim text <= 6 words with object noun, readable in 3:4 grid crop
Explicit share trigger exists (in script or caption: 'send this to...')
Every factual claim matches the source notes; required hedge words (often/many/some/might) present in narration AND captions; no absolute claim stronger than the source
No copyrighted music/footage/logos used as hero; brand names only referenced factually
No text/visual glitches: no clipped words, no overlapping captions, no off-palette colours, no empty frames
Caption first line is the SEO question with the object noun; 3-5 hashtags; pinned comment has a 1-word question and >= 1 source
Audio: VO peaks <= -1 dBTP, music ducked >= 10 dB under VO, SFX present on hook, history pivot and payoff

qa_gate_rule: Post only if 0 blockers fail and <= 2 majors fail. Otherwise fix and re-render, or skip the day.
